_meta.description: Canonical claim registry for Perseus Computing public surfaces. Every public figure derives from here. When a benchmark re-runs, update THIS file only; scripts/render_claims.py regenerates manifest strings and tests/test_claims_sync.py fails CI if any surface drifts.
_meta.public_headline_policy: The latest completed three-run frozen-default official-CoT baseline is disclosed with each run, its equal-weight mean, pooled count, matched controls, and claim boundary. The separate evidence-structured paired confirmation remains a distinct experimental result and is not blended into the frozen-default series.
_meta.public_site_positioning: Perseus is the system around the model: Perseus resolves live context, Vault persists memory, and Ledger records evidence.

perseus_version.note: The source tree is prepared for 1.0.27, but the public package registry has not published it. Do not use this value as a package badge.

jcp_dd2345.detail: approved 2026-08-18; valid through 2031-08-18; this readiness credential does not grant technical-data access, CMMC/SPRS status, facility clearance, classified access, ATO, or partner fit

perseus_tool_count.detail: current default MCP contract; maintained for internal compatibility tests, not a public marketing count
perseus_tool_count.label: internal
perseus_tool_count.note: The advertised MCP surface is intentionally described without a fixed tool count because it can evolve.

tool_schema_reduction.detail: the current Perseus Vault registry publishes 173 canonical tools from 519 compatibility-manifest names (67% smaller); counts re-derived 2026-08-25 from the CI-enforced registry on main f48e528f89dfbce8c19c4a0714808a9d1fb728c; the exact public reference labels the --no-default-features profile and release
tool_schema_reduction.label: derived

token_ab_reduction.detail: fewer prompt tokens, full request (context + 14 user prompts, identical 72-token system stub excluded), cold cache; context-only reduction 52.71% cold and warm; naive full-file assembly (arm A) vs shipped-default `perseus render` subprocess (arm B) on the Perseus repo corpus at commit 9a8dd3ddae422786aae87c16a9807f73285296b6; 5 fixture docs exercising @include last=/since= windows, mode=reference, and the recall-first memory pointer, plus a no-windowing control doc that measured -8.69% (rendered arm slightly larger, showing no hidden constant); arm A 63,188 context tokens vs arm B 29,883; tiktoken cl100k_base; render overhead p50 341.5 ms cold / 315.6 ms warm, full subprocess incl interpreter startup, timed inside the window
token_ab_reduction.label: measured

token_reduction_pct.detail: 488->27 avg prompt tokens, 200-request A/B, 0 ms P99 overhead
token_reduction_pct.label: synthetic
token_reduction_pct.note: Retired 2026-07-16 (#803): harness is asymmetric. State A adds a hard-coded +250 token orientation penalty (benchmark/telemetry/hooks.py); State B counts only the compiled context and drops the user prompt; both arms are stub calls so the 0 ms overhead is by construction. Do not publish any of 94% / 488->27 / 0 ms until the honest re-run in #804 lands.

cold_warm_speedup.detail: cold 619.10s -> warm 1.014s across 22,528 varied directives (22 types) against the real Perseus repo; the artifact's own headline figure. The previously published 1,190x was the best single block, not the average; retired 2026-07-16 (#803)
cold_warm_speedup.label: measured

longmemeval_qa.detail: historical plain-prompt mean of 3 runs (72.8/73.6/75.0); longmemeval_s 500, gpt-4o-2024-08-06 answerer + official per-type judge; retained as a separate methodology result, not the current paired-confirmation headline
longmemeval_qa.label: measured-plain-prompt

longmemeval_cot.detail: three accepted full 500-question frozen-default official-CoT runs: Run 1 80.2% (401/500), Run 2 80.6% (403/500), Run 3 81.8% (409/500); equal-weight mean and pooled result 80.9% (1213/1500); matched full-context controls 66.8% / 66.6% / 67.4% (66.9% pooled), gold-session oracle controls 90.2% / 91.6% / 90.6% (90.8% pooled); all runs used the named answerer and official per-type judge at temperature 0; correction attempts are disclosed in the public series report
longmemeval_cot.label: measured-three-run-mean
longmemeval_cot.note: This is a company-run benchmark result for one dataset, protocol, and model snapshot. It is not an independent holdout estimate, customer validation, production efficacy, or a claim about unrelated systems. The separate evidence-structured 82.0% paired confirmation is not blended into this series.

longmemeval_evidence_structured.detail: latest completed full 500-question paired internal confirmation (410/500) using the official-CoT answer prompt, evidence-structured candidate context, and a matched full-context control at 83.2% (416/500); delta -1.2 percentage points; 38 gains vs 44 regressions; execution and custody accepted, preregistered success rule failed, no automatic promotion; official evaluator cross-check unavailable locally
longmemeval_evidence_structured.label: measured-paired-confirmation
longmemeval_evidence_structured.note: This is not an independent holdout estimate, a product-superiority claim, or production authorization. A provider-free attribution rerun remains incomplete and is not used as a score. It is kept separate from the frozen-default three-run series.
longmemeval_evidence_structured.source: internal custody artifact; sanitized public report not yet published

longmemeval_retrieval_recall10.detail: session-level retrieval recall@k, retrieval-only; hybrid recall@1 83.2%, recall@3 96.6%, recall@5 98.8%, recall@10 99.8%, MRR 0.8949 on the current-main 500-instance report
longmemeval_retrieval_recall10.label: measured

locomo_overall.detail: LOCOMO categories 1-4, top-200 retrieval (1540 questions), gpt-5 answerer + judge, mem0's own harness forked; identical-corpus comparison reports Mem0 Platform 82.2% and Zep Cloud 33.8% (mem0's own published file scores 91.6 -- disclosed as judge/platform drift in the leaderboard)
locomo_overall.label: measured

locomo_adversarial.detail: LOCOMO category-5 adversarial (446 questions), same forked mem0 harness; Mem0 Platform 55.6%, Zep Cloud 49.8%; Perseus Vault is a fully local single binary, time-to-searchable instant vs Mem0 ~11-45s and Zep ~222s
locomo_adversarial.label: measured

vault_durable_write_100k.detail: durable sustained write @100K -- DISTINCT from in-memory bulk insert
vault_durable_write_100k.label: measured

vault_bulk_insert.detail: in-memory bulk insert, 100K in 1.01s -- NOT a sustained durable write rate
vault_bulk_insert.label: unverified
vault_bulk_insert.note: Retired 2026-07-16 (#803): no artifact exists anywhere in the perseus-vault repo; the only source was the README sentence itself. Vault-side removal tracked in perseus-vault#702. Use vault_durable_write_100k (signed scale report) instead.

hybrid_recall_speedup.detail: 295.5->80.9 ms p50 @100K on AMD64/Windows box (NOT MI300X)
hybrid_recall_speedup.label: measured

mi300x_dollar_per_agent_hr.detail: $0.143 vs $1.68/agent-hr (2xH100); hardware economics, NOT a customer cost-savings claim
mi300x_dollar_per_agent_hr.label: measured

temporal_correctness.detail: 13 of 13 deterministic temporal-gauntlet fixture cases passed; no external control or baseline; this validates the committed fixture contract only and does not establish customer-workload accuracy or production authorization
temporal_correctness.label: measured

beam_correctness.detail: 100% gauntlet correctness at every BEAM token tier (128K/500K/1M/10M); the embedded bi-temporal gauntlet reused verbatim, offline, lean FTS5 + bi-temporal binary
beam_correctness.label: measured

beam_determinism.detail: two independent runs produce an identical PASS/FAIL signature at every tier (128K/500K/1M/10M)
beam_determinism.label: measured

beam_as_of_p50_10m.detail: point-lookup as_of p50 at the 10M-token tier; stays flat from 128K (22.08 ms) to 10M (23.07 ms), 40 samples/tier
beam_as_of_p50_10m.label: measured

beam_scale_10m.detail: top tier = 153,846 filler entities, ~10.1M tokens (10,115,374), 332.43s populate; Linux/Unraid
beam_scale_10m.label: measured

memconflict_macro.detail: macro score in a self-run replication of the third-party MemConflict protocol; 8 self-hosted memory providers and 3,750 questions, with the canonical report linked on the detail page
memconflict_macro.label: measured-replication

cost_savings_pct.detail: fewer dollars at +11.7 pts accuracy; Baseline-A (full-context) UPPER BOUND, n=60 stratified, rate-invariant; per-type gate (knowledge-update regressed)
cost_savings_pct.label: illustrative-baseline-A
cost_savings_pct.note: Owner decision 2026-07-14: keep behind the illustrative calculator / signed cert context; do NOT publish as a marketing headline.

binary_size.note: No size-measurement artifact; README ~8MB and legacy 3.7MB both unbacked. Do not publish a hard size.

vs_llm_speedup_301x.note: extreme_week_results.json absent from main. Do not publish until an artifact is committed.

enterprise_roi_90pct.note: extreme_enterprise_results_full.json absent (broken link). Do not publish.

tool_scope_agent_tier.detail: PERSEUS_VAULT_TOOL_SCOPE=agent advertises 54 of 173 canonical MCP tools — a 69% smaller advertised surface for agent clients; advertisement-only (tools/call unaffected; authorization stays workspace binding + authority manifests); source-derived from perseus-vault main f48e528f89dfbce8c19c4a0714808a9d1fb728c on 2026-08-25; the exact count is release/profile-specific
tool_scope_agent_tier.source: perseus-vault src/mcp.rs TOOL_SCOPES side table + scripts/registry_metadata_check.py
tool_scope_agent_tier.label: derived

memora_locomo_s_baseline.detail: Microsoft Memora semantic retriever (S) on LoCoMo cats 1-4 (1,540 QA), re-run on Perseus Computing hardware 2026-08-15; gpt-4.1-mini judge+answerer, temp 0, top_k 30; overall LLM-judge 0.8591, per-cat 0.7908/0.8505/0.6458/0.9096; paper reports 0.849 under a gpt-4o-mini judge (different judge - brackets the published range, not a parity claim); NOT a head-to-head vs Perseus Vault
memora_locomo_s_baseline.label: measured-baseline

memora_locomo_p_baseline.detail: Microsoft Memora policy/prompted retriever (P) on LoCoMo cats 1-4 (1,540 QA), re-run on Perseus Computing hardware 2026-08-15; gpt-4.1-mini judge+answerer, temp 0, top_k 30; overall LLM-judge 0.8740, per-cat 0.8085/0.8598/0.6667/0.9251; paper reports 0.863 under a gpt-4o-mini judge (different judge - brackets the published range, not a parity claim); NOT a head-to-head vs Perseus Vault
memora_locomo_p_baseline.label: measured-baseline

capabilities.freshness_rule: Re-verify when renderer, resolver, or generated artifact changes.

non_claims: This does not certify arbitrary third-party directives or downstream model behavior.

capabilities.freshness_rule: Re-verify when artifact schemas or budget accounting changes.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Artifacts carry deterministic schema, source commitments, and bounded sections.
non_claims: A commitment proves integrity of supplied inputs, not their truth.

capabilities.freshness_rule: Re-verify when context-contract schema or projection fields change.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: The bounded rank, ask, and projection paths expose sanitized evidence metadata and explicit non-success states.
non_claims: Ranking is not a truth oracle and does not replace Vault or Ledger authority.

capabilities.freshness_rule: Re-verify when graph, expansion, verdict, or budget logic changes.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: The compiler emits digest-sealed graph and packet decisions under explicit hard limits.
non_claims: Rendered accounting is not provider billing or a hardware benchmark.

capabilities.capability: Vault-backed context with explicit degraded fallback
capabilities.freshness_rule: Re-verify when connector transport, fallback, or serving policy changes.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Unavailable Vault integration is surfaced as a bounded degraded path rather than an equivalent complete result.
non_claims: The fallback is not a replacement for Vault durability, provenance, or retrieval authority.

non_claims: No unreviewed extension is part of the default runtime guarantee.
